docs.text: Color Themes ¶ The Chess Board Drawer application offers several elegant color themes for your chess board. Each theme provides a unique visual style while maintaining excellent contrast between squares. Available Themes ¶ The following themes are available in the application: Classic ¶ The traditional chess board colors used in many tournaments. Light squares: #EEEED2 (cream) Dark squares: #769656 (forest green) Vintage ¶ A warm, wooden appearance reminiscent of antique chess sets. Light squares: #E8D0AA (light tan) Dark squares: #B67C4A (medium brown) Purple ¶ A modern, vibrant purple theme with excellent contrast. Light squares: #E6D5F5 (light lavender) Dark squares: #9966CC (amethyst purple) Gray ¶ A minimalist grayscale theme for a clean, professional look. Light squares: #E8E8E8 (light gray) Dark squares: #707070 (medium gray) Blue ¶ A calming blue theme that's easy on the eyes. Light squares: #D6E5FA (pale blue) Dark squares: #5D8BF4 (royal blue) Red ¶ A vibrant red theme for a bold, striking appearance. Light squares: #F5D5D5 (light pink) Dark squares: #D35D6E (raspberry red) Selecting a Theme ¶ To change the theme of your chess board: Locate the Themes section in the UI (at the bottom of the application) Click on any of the theme buttons to apply it The board will update immediately with the new colors Adding Custom Themes ¶ If you're a developer, you can easily add your own custom themes to the application by modifying the color_themes dictionary in the source code: # Add your custom theme color_themes [ "MyTheme" ] = { "light" : "#YOURCOLOR1" , "dark" : "#YOURCOLOR2" } When choosing colors for a custom theme, consider these guidelines: Ensure high contrast between light and dark squares Test your theme for visibility of chess pieces (especially in the chess game component) Use web-safe colors or hexadecimal color codes Theme Implementation Details ¶ Each theme in the application is implemented as a dictionary entry with two color values: color_themes = { "Classic" : { "light" : "#EEEED2" , "dark" : "#769656" }, # Other themes... } When a theme is selected, the application: Retrieves the light and dark colors from the theme dictionary Redraws the entire board using the new colors Updates the UI to highlight the currently selected theme For more details on the implementation, see the change_theme() function in the API reference.
